build_vit_base_model: build a ViT-B/16 vision transformer model with 768 embedding dim and 12 layers
build_vit_large_model: build a ViT-L/16 vision transformer model with 1024 embedding dim and 24 layers
build_vit_huge_model: build a ViT-H/14 vision transformer model with 1280 embedding dim and 32 layers
create_vision_transformer_with_global_po: create a VisionTransformer instance with global average pooling enabled for feature extraction
review_forward_features_method: review the forward_features method that processes patches through transformer blocks and returns pooled features
